classification: post-hoc temporal-extension validation of the frozen R343 10% C satellite portfolio with monthly gold 200-day trend proxy

gold_proxy.rule: monthly close > 200-day MA uses gold; otherwise 50/50 treasury+dividend

limits: The extension is quasi-out-of-sample, not independent: earlier factor research may have observed the same market history.
The common window begins in 2022 because TTM financial factors are unavailable earlier; it is not a 2018-2026 test.
The gold trend rule, 10% C cap and broad C sleeve are post-hoc choices.
Current-snapshot industry classification, reconstructed membership and ETF qfq caches are not full vendor PIT data.
The proxy does not model intraday execution or ETF premium/discount.
